outcome: Presence of microorganisms in fetal membranes and placental tissue
cohort: 31 women with preterm premature rupture of membranes or preterm labour and preterm delivery by caesarean section, and 26 women undergoing elective caesarean section at term
finding: The combination of fluorescence in situ hybridization (FISH) and broad-range PCR identified Ureaplasma spp. as the most abundant microorganism in chorioamnionitis, highlighting its potential clinical significance.
